subject: Kindly Delivery Courier License Application
overview: The committee conducted an initial screening of a cannabis delivery operator application for a warehouse facility and authorized the applicant to proceed to the community meeting phase of the licensing process.

items.title: Kindly Delivery Application Review
items.summary: The committee reviewed an initial application for a cannabis delivery operator license at 86 Swan Street, which would involve a warehouse for local delivery with no public storefront. The application was approved to proceed to a community meeting.
